newsitem.title: USA: Dow at 10,000 in a year -- Prudential's Acampora.
newsitem.headline: Dow at 10,000 in a year -- Prudential's Acampora.

text.p: One of Wall Street's most outspoken bulls said on Thursday that the Dow Jones Industrial Average could hit 10,000 in a year's time.

Ralph Acampora, director of technical research at Prudential Securities, said in a report that assuming the U.S. stock market experiences a "blow off" buying panic, there is a good chance the Dow could hit the mark by the end of June 1998.
"Remain fully invested -- we expect the stock market to mount an explosive advance during the second half of this year," Acampora said in a report.
